name: separator
title: Separator
description: A hairline between groups of content, optionally with a short label such as "or".

examples.name: separator-demo
examples.title: Separator
examples.description: Horizontal between blocks, vertical between inline items.

examples.name: separator-with-label
examples.title: With a label
examples.description: An "or" divider between two ways to sign in.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Vertical separators stretch to the height of their flex row.

props.name: label
props.description: Text in the middle of a horizontal rule. The result is read as its text, not as a separator.

props.name: elementType
props.description: Element to render (React Aria). Horizontal defaults to <hr>.

notes: role="separator" (an <hr> when horizontal); vertical separators get aria-orientation="vertical".
A labelled separator is a plain group with visible text and aria-hidden hairlines.

do: Use spacing first; add a separator only when groups would otherwise run together.
dont: Don't use separators for decoration inside dense lists; use row borders.
